description: Posts one durable, low-noise update into a Chat room without waiting for another human turn. Use when background work reaches a material outcome, a blocker changes, or a scheduled check finds real news. Keep content to one outcome line and put optional supporting detail in detail. idempotency_key is required so retries never duplicate a message.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact update.

sender_id.description: Stable seat handle shown as the author.

source_ref.description: Optional job, card, run, or commit reference.

thread_id.description: Chat thread UUID receiving the update.

name: post_room_update
title: Post a proactive room update
